lines.en: scene tsukasaamibj1
With her first somewhat legitimate session of self-pleasure in the books and her Plush-pal Armada only mildly traumatized, stocks in Tsukasa Tsukioka’s virginity had somehow begun to stagnate.
lines.zh: 第一次「多少算合法」的自我取悦已经入账,玩偶舰队也只受了点轻伤,月冈月司「童贞」的股价竟开始停滞。

lines.en: With the numbers of her latest earnings report coming in right on estimate, in combination with her 50-day SMA, shareholders can no longer remain bullish on the presence of her hymen and see no growth potential at all in an entity so willing to adapt to greater market trends instead of capitalizing on its niche sector.
lines.zh: 她最新的财报数字完全符合预估,再加上她的五十日简单移动平均线(SMA),股东们再也无法对她的处女膜保持看涨——在一个如此乐于顺应更大的市场趋势、而不肯深耕利基领域的实体身上,看不到任何增长潜力。

lines.en: Now, if you’re one of those people who can’t quite tell the difference between a 401k and a traditional IRA, you might not understand what any of this means. So why don’t I go ahead and simplify it for you?
lines.zh: 现在,如果你属于那类分不清 401k 和传统 IRA 的人,你可能完全不明白这些在说什么。那我不妨替你简化一下?

lines.en: A few hours ago, you had two lines. One line was going up and one line was going straight. But the first line was only going up because it didn’t know which direction it was supposed to go in.
lines.zh: 几个小时前,你有两条线。一条在往上走,一条是水平线。但第一条线之所以往上走,只是因为它不知道自己该往哪个方向去。

lines.en: Now, it’s corrected itself for both lack of a better term and additional comedy for my TA fans out there.
lines.zh: 现在,它已经自我修正了——既因为找不到更好的说法,也为了给正在读 TA 分析的我那些粉丝增加一点喜剧效果。

lines.en: It’s not the product we wanted. It was just the idea of the product. And now that we have access to the product, we no longer have any need for the product because, again, the product wasn’t a product but a thought.
lines.zh: 那不是我们想要的产品。只是「关于产品的念头」。而如今既然我们能接触到产品本身,我们反而不再需要它了——因为,再说一遍,那根本不是产品,只是一个念头。

lines.en: So while one more bipedal failed venture may have found its way to a door it shouldn’t knock on, we must swallow our pride or whatever it is we still have after all of this time and accept that our ideals were never ours at all.
lines.zh: 所以,又一个直立行走的失败创投敲响了一扇它本不该敲的门,而我们必须咽下自尊——或者熬过这一切之后还剩下的任何东西——承认:我们的理想,从来就不属于我们。

lines.en: They were but cherry-picked sentences and concepts we could hide behind for cover as arrows fletched from moral ambiguity and immoral perpetuity rain down upon us.
lines.zh: : 它们只是我们精心挑选的句子和概念,躲在后面当掩体,以便在用「道德模糊」与「不道德永恒」削成的箭雨落下来时,可以替我们挡一挡。

lines.en: When we’ve all been pierced or pinned to the ground, I hope there will be no clouds to shield us from the sun as we all hoped and expected there would be.
lines.zh: : 当我们全都被射穿、或被钉在地上,我希望天上没有云来替我们挡太阳——尽管我们都曾那样盼望、那样期待。

lines.en: Let us cook in the fire of this universe, God, and add ten more footnotes to excuse the dreaded size difference.
lines.zh: : 让我们在这宇宙与神的火里烹煮吧,神,并在脚注上再添十条,好为那可怕的尺寸差开脱。

lines.en: And stop praying on behalf of voodoo dolls when the bodies they inhabit and embolden, together and separate, are the bits and pieces of humanity that truly do crash and burn like meme stocks.
lines.zh: : 也请别再替巫毒娃娃祈祷了——它们所寄宿、所壮胆的躯体,合在一起也好,分开也罢,才是真正像 meme 股一样崩盘燃烧的人性的碎片。
